principles: Prefer the responsible land manager or route steward with an accessible maintained source.
Distinguish authoritative ownership, update delivery, per-feature survey dates, and geometric agreement. A recent service timestamp alone proves none of the latter.
Keep official colors and route identities when changing geometry sources.
Treat crossings and shared tread separately from duplicates. Preserve cross-boundary continuations and the entire Rivanna network.
Source preferences require a concrete bounded replacement plan before any existing geometry is changed.

sources.name: USFS National Forest System Trails
sources.authority: Official Forest Service enterprise publication for National Forest system trails
sources.updates: EDW documentation says daily refresh from forest databases; individual geometry may originate from older surveys. This pipeline monitors the service.
sources.limitations: No blaze colors or per-feature survey/update date in the reviewed feed; some hiking management is ambiguous.

sources.name: APPA Official Centerline — NPS / ATC
sources.authority: NPS-owned service used directly by the live ATC interactive map, built cooperatively with NPS. Verified owner jlfoster@nps.gov_nps, NPS organization fBc8EJBxQRMcHlei.
sources.updates: Active centralized route source; layer data edit timestamp 2026-10-28T16:24:29.645000+00:00. This is not a survey date. Regional records mostly cite 2001–2003 and 2015–2017 GPS surveys.
sources.limitations: New official reference for this exception round only, not an approved replacement. Preserve the existing route extent and verify changes before migration.

sources.name: Existing Appalachian Trail import
sources.authority: Original upstream provenance was not retained in feature attributes; local features have only empty Name/description.
sources.updates: Mapbox dataset last modified 2020-01-09. That dates the local import, not necessarily its survey. No current upstream adapter.
sources.limitations: Do not assume the existing geometry is wrong; compare it with the steward-maintained reference.

sources.name: Virginia DCR State Parks GIS
sources.authority: Official park operator GIS, already ingested with stable GlobalIDs and source URLs.
sources.updates: Existing monitored DCR pipeline; no fixed upstream update cadence asserted.
sources.limitations: Retain park-specific names/blazes and use USFS only for separately reviewed continuations outside the shared park tread.

sources.name: Existing Tuscarora line in Shenandoah upload
sources.authority: Attributes identify PATC maintainer and Jim Tomlin (PATC), differential GPS, claimed horizontal accuracy >1m to <5m, blue blaze.
sources.updates: Source/GPS date 2019-12-21; local tileset uploaded in March 2020. No current refresh source is configured.
sources.limitations: This is documented survey data, not an unverified crowd trace. USFS is easier to maintain, but its geometry is not automatically more accurate. Uploaded tiles have no editable source dataset; retain all unaffected NPS/PATC geometry when planning any replacement.

sources.name: TNC official georeferenced maps
sources.authority: Official preserve operator maps, exact vector extraction.
sources.updates: Maps dated 2020/2021; source URLs monitored and changed PDFs require revalidation.
sources.limitations: Sandy Gap TNC east and west already explicitly accepted. USFS alternate is resolved for this round.
